features: ✔️ EASY TO USE: No need to be a professional to use it. Get the dull blade in place, right on the sharpening slot, stroke towards you, (one direction only, do not move backward & forward) from heel to tip, 3 or 4 times in each slot and your knives & scissors are ready to be used again. Quick, fast and safe. No Rust and no more grinding and damaging your knives with handheld stones.

✔️ RELIABLE: Stop throwing away blunt knives, dull scissors, and shears and save money. This top of the line manual sharpening tool helps repair them, from coarse to fine sharpened. Designed to fit all kitchen knives and scissors sizes, and keep them sharp as new or better. No matter if you are right or left handed, you can use it from either side.

✔️ SAFE: Ergonomically engineered. The silicon handle and the cushioned non slip pads, provide the optimum control for a safe job. It is big enough to be handled properly and small enough to fit into any kitchen drawer. The ideal manual sharpener for everyone, from chefs to seniors.

✔️ KITCHEN PROFESSIONAL: With 4 sharpening stages to offer: 1. For Scissors, and three materials for different levels of sharp 2. Coarse, 3. Fine, 4. Ceramic. Get the best knife sharp for all different level of dullness. It works for ceramic, stainless steel, butcher axes, etc. Perfect to sharpen all kinds of blades like Chef's, Utility, Paring, Clip Point, Tourné, Slicers, Boning, Filleting and Cleaver knives, all kinds except serrated ones.

description: Pesinou 4 Stage Sharpening System Knives Sharpener

We believe that the family is the centerpiece of the society and the kitchen is the home's soul, every cutting instrument needs maintenance. So, We design this sharpener to encourage anyone who is looking for a healthier lifestyle to by providing high quality kitchen products. With Pesinou Multi-functional 4-in-1 Manual Knife & Scissor Sharpener, you will save precious time and effort when you cut vegetables, fruit or meat.

1. Fits All Knife and Scissors Sizes. 2. Four Slots: 4 slots of this sharpener satisfy your different sharpening needs. 3. Safety & Comfort: A non-slip rubber base and ergonomic handle. 4. High Quality: ABS plastic protects the knives scissors sharpener from embrittlement.

SLOT 1 - Diamond abrasives for scissor sharpening. SLOT 2 - Coarse (carbide blades), for the bluntest of knives. SLOT 3 - Medium (diamond abrasives), daily useage and ceramic knives. SLOT 4 - Fine (ceramic rods), final step, to clear up the burr of the knives after sharpening.

1. Do not pull your knife back and forth in the grinder slots, only can pull back. 2. It is normal for the rod on the sharpener to become black after use. 3. After grinding your knife, wipe the sharpener with a damp cloth or rinse with water, then wipe dry with a soft cloth to clean the metal part and ceramic rod.
